title: The Vigil
notes: One sky a day, a hundred floors, the same for everyone: the Vigil card on the worlds row, after the Gale. The day turns at midnight UTC; climb as often as you like, your best of the day counts.
The day's board: summits by time, then the highest climbs. A first summit earns Vigil Kept and the Watch stone finish.
The Vigil opens once the Foundry is lit.
The three-card deal is symmetric: every card the same size and larger, every blurb centred under its card.
